tasks.label: [BUILD] Odin: Build Debug
tasks.detail: Build (debug) the project containing the active file. Project is detected from ${file} (must live under code/projects/<project>/).

tasks.label: [BUILD] Odin: Build Release
tasks.detail: Build (release, -o:speed) the project containing the active file.

tasks.label: [BUILD] Odin: Hot Reload - Build DLL
tasks.detail: Build the hot-reload DLL for the project containing the active file.

tasks.label: [BUILD] Odin: Run Debug
tasks.detail: Build then run the debug binary for the project containing the active file.

tasks.label: [DEV] Odin: Check (vet only)
tasks.detail: Run odin check (vet + strict-style) on the project containing the active file.

tasks.label: [DIAG] Audit Cohérence READMEs
tasks.detail: Audit README <-> filesystem coherence (wikilinks, missing files, unlisted files). Use --fail-on-error in CI.

tasks.label: [DIAG] Vault Diagnostic
tasks.detail: Walk the whole repo and report issues per file: filename structure, frontmatter, content (H1 vs filename, long dashes). Use --fail-on-error in CI to break the build on any frontmatter error.

tasks.label: [DIAG] Validate Frontmatter
tasks.detail: Validate every .md file's YAML frontmatter against the 8-field OdinRAG schema. Exits 2 on any error. Runs an auto-fix for long dashes (en-dash/em-dash/horizontal bar -> ASCII '-').

tasks.label: [DIAG] Odin Code Audit (PVG03_RPG)
tasks.detail: Run the headless Odin code auditor against PVG03_RPG/src. Writes the Markdown report to _Helpers/scripts/diagnostic/code_auditor/latest_audit.md. Exit code is non-zero on error (2) or warning+--strict (1).

tasks.label: [DIAG] Odin Code Audit (single file prompt)
tasks.detail: Prompts for a file or path then runs code_auditor.py against it (use Run -> Input variant). Default: prints to stdout.

tasks.label: [PUBLISH] --check (dry-run)
tasks.detail: Dry-run: regenerate public from main locally, audit, no pushes. Use to preview before the real publish.

tasks.label: [PUBLISH] full (private + regen + public)
tasks.detail: Daily publish flow: push main to private, regenerate public (filtered), push public to remote. Refuses on dirty working tree. Uses --force-with-lease on the public push.

tasks.label: [PUBLISH] --skip-private
tasks.detail: Same as [PUBLISH] full but skip the private push (use when you already pushed main to private manually).
